4th - Courtney 12/19/2025 12:29 PM
  • I do somewhat regret not flipping at gersh at f6. I think it would've set me up for end game much better. I do appreciate the last few days I was able to spend with gersh tho in the game. He definitely kept me sane, and we had a lot of fun playing games together LOL
  • that being said, I'm kind of sad that he wouldn't risk sending me to fire. I think at the end of all of this, Saul was the best #1 i could ask for. I think we matched each other on a game level and personal level so well that we just worked so seamlessly together. He was always honest with me and his biggest flaw was having a big ass, leaky mouth LOLOL. But i appreciate that he was never threatened by me threat level and would've gone to the end with me. Gersh and even CJ a little bit disappointed me in that regard. Less CJ though because i do think we drifted during the merge middle of merge, so I'm not super surprised he let me go without a fight. But for gersh, we played most of this game together, i literally blew up my game for him, and and if the roles were reversed, i 100% would've sent him to fire and risk a shakey FTC next to him. So that kind of sucked that I don't think the loyalty went both ways. I'm not completely obtuse though and ofc I realize if it was saul, gersh, and I in the end, I would've cut gersh. But in any other timeline with Saul not present, I take gersh 1000%. Like yes Saul was my #1, but obviously gersh still meant a lot to me in this game, and i wouldn't have fought Saul so hard to keep him if I didn't care about him as an ally. And in the actual present timeline we were in, we did have a chance to ride it to the end together. And y'all, i in full faith believe gersh had a game as good as mine to present to the jury that was willing to be heard out. It just kind of sucks he didn't have that same faith in his own game to go up against mine.
 (edited)
4th - Courtney 12/19/2025 12:38 PM
  • Also why did I lowkey eat this season LOLOL. Like I was actually really sad on Wednesday knowing I was about to get cut. I tried pitching to CJ and worked really hard on Gersh to just give me one more chance. LIKE UGH I WAS SO CLOSE. Also yes, i had a good social game, but for all the doubters in jury (I'm looking at you John Michael BAHAHA), i definitely had strategy as well. Whether intentional or not (LOL), i had a hand in flushing all the advantages at merge. I got rid of Jah's idol (shoutout to Saul on that but i was going to throw a stray no matter what). I got rid of Smite's KiP. I made sure Jah went out on Leif's idol play in a one and done scenario instead of letting it go to a tie between him and smite which was good because I was closer to smite. Also I was the one who chose Shinx to go home during the double, and we got rid of his mustard gas because of it. OH and JM's extra vote??? Ofc i knew it would've been useful for the f7 round, but hell no was I going to risk him potentially using that on me. So when Saul was in trouble, i tried to put a little bit of pressure on him to use it for the double. Also guys ngl, i had some good jury management this season LOLOLOL. Nick is probably the only really questionable one, but I didn't burn Jah/Shinx/Leif too much imo where they feel bitter at me for voting them out. And then Adam, JM, and Saul were basically locked votes for me like wow crazy. Also let's be real, i was the glue/centerpiece of #⏪-fob-⏩ bridging both the bio and physicist boys for an alliance that controlled the first half of merge. Not to flex but to flex LOL.
  • speaking of which, going into jury and reading the messages about the "war to be courtney's #1" is so silly goofy LOLOL. That's actually so funny. I was not expecting that. but hey, social game goes hard i guess! And i think it just showed that I had options. but grrr just makes me even sadder about what could've been if i had just pulled through for 2 more rounds
 (edited)
12:43 PM
  • Overall though, what a great season! I'm ngl, i was a little skeptical after finding out I was literally 1 of 3 females on this cast just for it to go down to 2.... And i was like oh i am DOOMED. But this cast was so great and so much fun. I feel like I made some really good connections and memories this season. I think this cast also made me like VCing a bit more? Ew. But VCing in #⏪-fob-⏩ will definitely be a highlight for me. Or when we played Jackbox before the double with prod... that was really fun too. But even though the testotserone levels were through the ROOF this season, I really cherish the connections I made with CJ, Gersh, JM, Adam, William, Small Might, and ofc Saul a lot. And yeah everyone else was really cool too. I'm actually super glad I got to play this season even though I hate orging !!! But i'm sick in the head. what can i say?
